erin_cs: Heads-up — Halcyon Labs showing a steep drop in activity, renewal in ~5 weeks. Daily calls down ~75% this month.
support_bot: [ALERT] Halcyon Labs - Usage -75% (30d), Active seats: 7/40, Health: 29/100. Report: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/halcyon/health
vikram_csm: any signs of outages or a champion leaving?
olga_ae: sales notes: product lead says there's a temporary spend freeze and they're evaluating NeonAI. They asked for latency logs export.
platform_se: looked at traces from their dedicated node — KV cache thrash + long tail during batched vector ops. Filed TKT-12077.
erin_cs: so risk = spend freeze + infra frag + competitor eval. Recommend escalation play: 1) exec check-in with new owner, 2) offer 2-week no-cost perf POC (we run config + bench), 3) fast patch for TKT-12077, 4) short enablement session for their SREs.
vikram_csm: assigning: outreach->me; infra fix->@platform_se; pricing/comparison->@olga_ae. I'll offer up to $4k in credits if needed.
platform_se: patch candidate identified (KV pinning + cache tuning). ETA for canary: 36h. I'll include a 1-page runbook for immediate mitigations.
olga_ae: outreach draft: "We noticed activity drop — can we run a zero-cost 2-week perf POC on your dataset and share a side-by-side report vs NeonAI? We'll include config and cost analysis." feedback?
erin_cs: add a line: "Post-POC we'll deliver a 1-page exec summary highlighting unit economics and p99 improvements."
support_bot: [REMINDER] Follow-up in 48h for customer response.
vikram_csm: will ping them now and update thread. If they ask for PO to unlock discounts, escalate to sales ops and loop me.
